title: Perfect hobby
objectives: talk about leisure preferences using like/love/hate + -ing

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Perfect hobby.
Welcome to today's lesson: Perfect hobby! Today we will practice how to talk about leisure preferences using like/love/hate + -ing.

elements.content: talk about leisure preferences using like/love/hate + -ing; identify popular hobbies

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: reading, cooking, painting, dancing, music, cinema

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Complete: 'I love ___ books in my free time.'

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: I love cooking and listening to music. What is your perfect hobby?

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
My perfect hobby is reading. My sister loves dancing and painting. We both enjoy good music.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Share three hobbies you love doing in your free time and one you dislike.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: talk about leisure preferences using like/love/hate + -ing, identify popular hobbies.
